capabilities: Edit block-reference cards in place and write back to the source note
Group nodes into labelled frames and align, distribute and multi-select them
Draw labelled connections with semantic relations and per-node colours
Chat with an AI over selected nodes and insert answers as nodes or notes
Run a board health check, navigate with a minimap and export boards as Markdown
extras: Desktop only; requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. No telemetry and no background requests; AI calls go only to the user's own provider when explicitly sent. Boards stay JSON Canvas-compatible and uninstall leaves notes untouched.
intentEvidence: Volis starts where Obsidian Canvas stops.
problem: Canvas nodes only hold a link and cannot be edited, typed, related to each other or analyzed without leaving the board.
